evidencePolicy.rule: No issue closes without machine-emitted evidence: a verifier run at a pinned commit, with can-fail proof (dedicated negatives or a fully-caught mutant set), stamped with the current commit and relevant working-tree state.
evidencePolicy.commitStamps: every evidence JSON carries currentCommit; a cell goes stale when its relevant files changed after that commit
evidencePolicy.mutationProofs: every verifier proves its suite CAN FAIL via negative cases or caught mutants

issues.scope: M29 ledger, closure gate, verify wiring; M28 bar re-audit automated (ladder discipline).
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger + gate + wiring
M28 bar automated re-audit
Vocabulary lint over M29 artifacts

issues.scope: Document and mechanize the onboarding protocol: analyzer #419 conformance -> position gate -> freshness gate -> IDE fixtures -> mutants -> latency budget -> claim-level assignment. One command runs the full checklist for a candidate language (contract §9 binding enforced mechanically: IDE claim level <= analyzer evidence level).
acceptanceCriteria: Wave gate runner script; per-step pass/fail output
Binding enforced: claim level capped by #419 state mechanically
Protocol documented as the checklist a new language walks
closureRequirements: Runner evidence on a dry-run language

issues.scope: Execute R1 for the next language(s) chosen by the #419 ledger at execution time (candidates: javascript INVENTORY-DONE, vue NOT-STARTED; actual set owner-approved). End-to-end: gates, fixtures, mutants, budgets, claim levels, IDE matrix updated.
acceptanceCriteria: Wave gate green for the onboarded language(s)
All M24 feature evidence regenerated for the new language(s)
Capability matrix + precision ledger updated (drift-gated)
closureRequirements: Owner approval of the language set recorded before execution

issues.scope: Hover/navigation latency on M19-scale corpora (intellij-community subsets etc.) through the IDE stack where feasible; results recorded with machine + corpus revision. Any budget miss is a filed defect, not a footnote.
acceptanceCriteria: Measured percentiles on named corpora + revisions
In-editor runs where the runner allows; server-level otherwise, declared
Misses filed as defects with evidence
closureRequirements: Defect issues linked for any miss

issues.scope: Published per-language/per-feature precision table: claim level, evidence path, differential sampling results, heuristic-edge ratios, limitations. Regeneration script + drift gate (hand-edits reopen the gate).
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger generated from evidence files; drift-gated
Published in docs + marketplace listing updated
Staleness policy documented

issues.scope: Evidence-driven precision work surfaced by R4 (e.g. heuristic-edge reduction feeding the inferred-tier ratio). Each fix lands fixture-first with a permanent mutant (F7 rule).
acceptanceCriteria: Each improvement: fixture authored before fix, mutant added, gate green
Ledger reflects improved ratios (regenerated)
No improvement claimed without its mutant

issues.scope: The R1 runner and R4 generator as permanent, wired, fail-able tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Runner + generator wired into verify
Positive+negative cases
Mutants for both (tamper -> fail)

issues.scope: The published precision ledger (docs + listing) and the wave protocol documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Both artifacts generated from evidence, drift-gated
Vocabulary lint green
Claim levels match ledger

issues.scope: Program-level closure: every version's completion bar (M24-M29) re-verified at current HEAD; every claim level re-checked; every limitation still declared; owner spot-checks recorded. The program is closed only on this evidence — the owner declares the idea achieved, per the spot-check ritual.
acceptanceCriteria: Ladder audit: M24-M29 bars green at current HEAD, machine-checked
All claim levels re-validated against evidence freshness
Owner spot-check results (including discrepancies) appended to program evidence
